description: This Java class, JsLanguageFileMappingCreator, generates a Java source file that maps various language-specific JavaScript files needed for internationalization purposes in the OFBiz framework. It uses locale information to locate the correct resource files and creates a class with mappings for different JavaScript localization files. The process involves reading locale data, checking for corresponding files, and rendering the results into a Java class using a FreeMarker template.

classes.name: JsLanguageFileMappingCreator
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating the Java source code for language file mappings based on locale information and template rendering.

methods.name: createJsLanguageFileMapping
methods.description: Static method that creates or updates the Java class mapping language-specific JavaScript files by processing locale data, checking the existence of resource files, and rendering a FreeMarker template into the target Java source file.
